license_required.quote: an individual or a firm not holding a valid CPA or public accountant certificate under this article or permit under IC 25-2.1-5 may not issue a report on financial or attested statements of another individual, member, organization, or governmental unit.

issuing_authority.quote: The board shall issue a CPA certificate to an individual who does the following

moral_character_required.quote: Demonstrates good character through lack of a history of dishonest or felonious acts.

degree_required.quote: a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board. The educational program must include an accounting concentration or equivalent as determined by the board to be appropriate.

accrediting_body.value: college or university acceptable to the board
accrediting_body.quote: a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

required.quote: An applicant for the initial issuance of a certificate under this chapter shall show that the applicant has had one (1) year of experience.

duration.quote: the applicant has had one (1) year of experience

kind.value: accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills
kind.quote: constitutes the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills as determined under the rules adopted by the board

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Board may use any part of the Uniform CPA Examination and Advisory Grading Service of the AICPA
exams.quote: use any part of the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination and Advisory Grading Service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

interval_years.quote: complete one hundred twenty (120) hours of continuing professional education during a three (3) year period

required.quote: to renew a certificate under this chapter an applicant must: (1) complete one hundred twenty (120) hours of continuing professional education during a three (3) year period with a minimum of twenty (20) hours each year

hours_per_period.quote: complete one hundred twenty (120) hours of continuing professional education during a three (3) year period

period_years.quote: complete one hundred twenty (120) hours of continuing professional education during a three (3) year period

available.quote: The board shall issue a CPA certificate to a holder of a certificate issued by another state if the holder meets the requirements under subsection (b) or (c).

requirements.value: Reciprocity available via substantial equivalency: board issues CPA certificate to out-of-state CPA if qualifications are substantially equivalent to Indiana requirements; or via traditional reciprocity requiring passage of exam, 4 years of experience in preceding 10 years, and CPE compliance.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a CPA certificate to a CPA certified by another state board or its designee if the board determines that the individual's CPA qualifications are substantially equivalent to the CPA licensure requirements of Indiana.

regulatory_model.quote: an individual or a firm not holding a valid CPA or public accountant certificate under this article or permit under IC 25-2.1-5 may not issue a report on financial or attested statements of another individual, member, organization, or governmental unit.

title_protection.quote: An individual may not use the title or designation "certified public accountant", the abbreviation "CPA", or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the individual is a certified public accountant unless the individual: (1) holds a valid CPA certificate

scope_protection.quote: an individual or a firm not holding a valid CPA or public accountant certificate under this article or permit under IC 25-2.1-5 may not issue a report on financial or attested statements of another individual, member, organization, or governmental unit.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving a peer review rating of fail or committing an act that is the basis of such a rating
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of IC 25-1-11-5, including: (A) a peer review rating of fail; or (B) an act or omission that is the basis of a peer review rating of fail

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before a state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before a state or federal agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of accountancy or in filing or failing to file own income tax returns
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or gross negligence in the practice of accountancy or in the filing of or failure to file the licensee's own income tax returns.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct reflecting adversely on the licensee's fitness to engage in the practice of accountancy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct reflecting adversely on the licensee's fitness to engage in the practice of accountancy.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to complete continuing education requirements satisfactorily
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to complete continuing education requirements satisfactorily.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish evidence, when required, of satisfactory completion of continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish evidence, when required, of satisfactory completion of continuing education requirements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering or rendering services or using the CPA title in another state and committing an act that would be disciplinable in that state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commits an act in that other state for which the CPA certificate holder would be subject to discipline in the other state if the CPA certificate holder were licensed in the other state.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of accountancy" means the performance or the offering to perform by a licensee of a service involving: (1) the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements; (2) management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services; or (3) the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of accountancy" means the performance or the offering to perform by a licensee of a service involving: (1) the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements; (2) management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services; or (3) the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

value: accounting or auditing skills, including issuance of reports on financial statements
management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services
preparation of tax returns or furnishing of advice on tax matters
methods_authorized.quote: the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of reports on financial statements; (2) management advisory, financial advisory, or consulting services; or (3) the preparation of tax returns or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

value: audit or other engagement under AICPA Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)
review of financial statement under AICPA Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS)
examination of prospective financial information under AICPA Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)
engagement under standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board
examination, review, or agreed upon procedure under SSAE (other than prospective financial information examination)
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means to provide any of the following services: (1) An audit or other engagement performed in accordance with the AICPA Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)... (2) A review of a financial statement performed in accordance with the AICPA Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS)... (3) An examination of prospective financial information performed in accordance with the AICPA Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)... (4) An engagement performed in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board. (5) An examination, a review, or an agreed upon procedure to be performed in accordance with the SSAE

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service of any compilation engagement to be performed in accordance with AICPA Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS).

education_semester_hours_required.quote: at least one hundred fifty (150) semester hours (or the equivalent if a different grading period is used) of college education

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: A first time examination candidate must have at least one hundred twenty (120) semester hours (or the equivalent if a different grading period is used) of college education

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: an individual who offers or renders professional services, in person or by mail, telephone, or other electronic means, as authorized under this section: (1) is not required to provide notice or other submissions to the board

value: consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
comply with this article and the board's rules
cease exercising the privilege if CPA certificate from principal place of business state is no longer valid
appointment of the state board or agency that issued the individual's license as agent for service of process
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: consent, as a condition of the grant of this privilege: (1) to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; (2) to comply with this article and the board's rules; (3) that if a certificate as a CPA from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual shall cease exercising the privilege granted under this section in Indiana, individually and on behalf of the CPA firm; and (4) to the appointment of the state board or agency that issued the individual's license as the individual's agent on whom process may be served

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: A holder of a CPA or PA certificate issued under this article may not perform attest services except through a firm that holds a valid permit under IC 25-2.1-5.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, belongs to holders of an active CPA certificate issued under this article or a corresponding certificate that is issued after examination by another state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A firm issued a permit under this section may include nonlicensee owners if: (1) the firm designates a licensee who is responsible for the proper registration of the firm and identifies that individual to the board; (2) all nonlicensee owners are active individual participants in the CPA or PA firm or affiliated entities

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board shall adopt rules that require as a condition to renew a permit under this chapter, that an applicant undergo, not more than once every three (3) years, a peer review conducted in a manner the board specifies.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: that an applicant undergo, not more than once every three (3) years, a peer review conducted in a manner the board specifies.

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: the proceedings, records, and work papers of a review committee are privileged and are not subject to discovery, subpoena, or other means of legal process or introduction into evidence in a civil action, arbitration, administrative proceeding, or board proceeding

inactive_license_status_available.quote: If a licensee desires to discontinue the practice of accountancy in Indiana, the licensee may select inactive or retired status on the renewal form. A licensee selecting inactive or retired status may renew a certificate under this chapter without completing the continuing professional education courses required by subsection (a).

retired_license_status_available.quote: the licensee may select inactive or retired status on the renewal form. A licensee selecting inactive or retired status may renew a certificate under this chapter without completing the continuing professional education courses required by subsection (a).

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: show that all attest and compilation services rendered in this state are under the charge of an individual holding a valid CPA certificate issued under this article or the corresponding provisions of another state.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: An individual licensee who is responsible for supervising attest or compilation services and signs or authorizes an individual to sign the accountant's report on behalf of the firm shall meet the competency requirements set out in the professional standards adopted by the board for the services.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: The information derived from or as the result of professional services is confidential and privileged.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a licensee or a partner, a member, a shareholder, an officer, a director, or an employee of a licensee...must remain the property of the licensee except in an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: This chapter does not apply to an individual or a firm: (1) that holds a designation granted in a foreign country entitling the holder to engage in the practice of accountancy or its equivalent in that country; (2) whose activities in Indiana are limited to the provision of professional services to individuals or firms who are residents, to governments, or to business entities of the country in which the individual holds the entitlement; (3) that does not issue reports with respect to the financial statements of another individual, firm, or governmental unit in Indiana

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this article is sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, restraining order, or conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Firms that fail to comply with this chapter due to changes in firm ownership or personnel, after receiving or renewing a permit, shall take corrective action to bring the firm into compliance as quickly as possible. The board may grant a reasonable time for a firm to take corrective action.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm may not provide attest services or use the title or designation "certified public accountant", the abbreviation "CPA"...unless: (1) the firm holds a valid permit issued under IC 25-2.1-5

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: "Accounting practitioner" means a person certified under IC 25-2.1-6.

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: the licensee may select inactive or retired status on the renewal form. A licensee selecting inactive or retired status may renew a certificate under this chapter without completing the continuing professional education courses required by subsection (a).

statute_of_limitations_for_accountant_ne.value: 1 year from discovery or 3 years from service/report, whichever is earlier
statute_of_limitations_for_accountant_ne.quote: An action under this chapter must be commenced by the earlier of the following: (1) One (1) year from the date the alleged act, omission, or neglect is discovered or should have been discovered by the exercise of reasonable diligence. (2) Three (3) years after the service for which the suit is brought has been performed or the date of the initial issuance of the accountant's report on the financial statements or other information.

independence_requirement_for_attest.quote: Rules of professional conduct directed to controlling the quality and probity of the practice of accountancy by licensees, including independence, integrity, and objectivity, competence and technical standards, and responsibilities to the public and clients.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: Upon a client's request, a licensee is required to provide the following to the client: (1) Client provided records in the licensee's custody or control. (2) Client records prepared by the licensee.
